evidence.detail: R55 RSFont calls this class repeatedly while parsing inline text markup during width/layout/render paths.
The class recognizes and decodes multiple inline tag families including pulse/color effects, fla/fla2, item=, color close/open controls, strike controls, tab= and yoff= values.

Its static methods return parsed integers/sentinel values consumed directly by RSFont as colors, sprite/item ids, style toggles, offsets and other text-render state rather than mutating unrelated client systems.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the central integer/sentinel parser used by RSFont inline markup.

evidence.detail: The class stores max/current/direction integers; each tick adds direction to current, flips to -1 at the configured upper bound, and flips back to +1 at zero.
R392 TextMarkupTagParser owns four static instances with bounds 25, 50, 125 and 250; Client advances all four once per live frame outside blocked rendering state.
The tag parser reads the 250-bound oscillator value while producing the dynamic color for its pulse-style text tag, fixing the class within text-effect animation rather than generic timing.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the bounded ping-pong counter used by text markup effects.
